mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM TBL_RESERVATION_SETTING ORDER BY SETTING_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT FROM TBL_RESERVATION_SETTING WHERE SETTING_ID = (SELECT MIN(SETTING_ID) FROM TBL_RESERVATION_SETTING) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_RESERVATION_SETTING.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBL_RESERVATION_SETTING (SETTING_ID, DAILY_CAPACITY, CLOSED_WEEKDAYS, HOLIDAY_CLOSED, UPDATED_AT, ADMIN_ID) VALUES (#{settingId}, #{dailyCapacity}, #{closedWeekdays,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{holidayClosed}, SYSDATE, #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_RESERVATION_SETTING SET DAILY_CAPACITY = #{dailyCapacity}, CLOSED_WEEKDAYS = #{closedWeekdays,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HOLIDAY_CLOSED = #{holidayClosed}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, ADMIN_ID = #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE SETTING_ID = #{settingId}
mapper.select: SELECT TRUNC(CLOSED_DATE) AS CLOSED_DATE, UPDATED_AT, ADMIN_ID FROM TBL_CLOSED_DAY ORDER BY CLOSED_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_CLOSED_DAY WHERE TRUNC(CLOSED_DATE) = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_CLOSED_DAY (CLOSED_DATE, UPDATED_AT, ADMIN_ID) VALUES (#{closedDate}, SYSDATE, #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.RESERVATION_NO, R.STATUS, R.PAY_STATUS, TRUNC(R.MOVE_DATE) AS MOVE_DATE, R.MOVE_TIME, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.PHONE, MR.HOUSE_TYPE, NVL(Q.FROM_ADDRESS, TRIM(MR.FROM_ADDRESS || ' ' || MR.FROM_DETAIL)) AS FROM_ADDRESS, NVL(Q.TO_ADDRESS, TRIM(MR.TO_ADDRESS || ' ' || MR.TO_DETAIL)) AS TO_ADDRESS FROM TBL_RESERVATION R JOIN TBL_MOVE_REQUEST MR ON MR.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID JOIN TBL_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = MR.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_QUOTE Q ON Q.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID WHERE R.STATUS IN ('01', '02') AND R.MOVE_DATE >= #{from} AND R.MOVE_DATE < #{to} ORDER BY R.MOVE_DATE, R.MOVE_TIME NULLS LAST, R.RESERVATION_ID
